method: Per-name distributions (n, p10/p25/p50/p75/p90) of major oxides. Rows filtered to whole-rock or volcanic-glass material with a 97-103 wt% major-oxide total counting iron once, and at least 6 (rocks) or 4 (minerals) reported oxides.
knownSourceDefect: Staged CSVs declare a 45-column header but emit 39 columns; the six volatile columns (H2O, CO2, F, Cl, SO3, S) are named and never written. Columns are remapped positionally by this script.
